Scroll ↓

Every terminal tool you use
already works inside Muxy.

Muxy is built on libghostty — the same rendering engine as Ghostty. If it runs in a terminal, it runs here. Zero configuration required to get started. Every config option available when you want it.

Features

01

Works with everything you already use

Neovim, tmux workflows, Claude Code, Cursor, zsh, fish, bash — if it runs in a terminal, it runs in Muxy. No adapters, no plugins, no changes.

02

Zero config to start

Open a folder and start working. No setup file required. Configure as much or as little as you want — Muxy works either way.

03

Project-based workspace

Every project gets its own tabs, splits, worktrees, and focus state. Close Muxy. Come back. Everything is where you left it.

04

Git without switching context

Stage, commit, push, pull, diff, branch, PR — in an attached panel that never obscures your terminal.

05

AI agent cockpit

Live usage quotas for Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor. Notification hooks. Unix socket IPC. Built for the way you work now.

Works with every AI tool you already use.
